name: rate_cards
title: Rate Cards
description: What an hour of human work costs, and for whom. A card scoped to a person AND a project beats one scoped to just the project, which beats one scoped to just the person, which beats the house default -- because the reason anyone writes a rate for 'Dana on the Acme rebuild' is that it must beat both of the others. The scope is READ from what a card carries rather than declared in a column of its own, so a card cannot resolve differently from how it reads. Cards VERSION FORWARD like billing_plans: a new rate is a new row with a later valid_from, never an edit, because an invoice must forever show the rate it was billed under and last quarter's unbilled hours belong to last quarter's rate (docs/logic-decisions.md #1). Resolution never looks forward -- the rate in force is the newest card that had already started when the work happened. increment_minutes lives here rather than in a global setting because rounding up to the next six minutes is a term of an engagement, not a preference of the server; it is the one number here that can only ever increase a bill, which is exactly why it belongs to something a client agreed to in writing.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.help: How this rate reads to a human: 'Standard engineering', 'Acme principal rate'.

fields.name: person_id
fields.label: Person
fields.help: Leave empty for a rate that applies to everyone in scope. Matched against a time entry's owner.

fields.name: project_id
fields.label: Project
fields.help: Leave empty for a rate that applies on every project.

fields.name: hourly_rate_cents
fields.label: Hourly Rate
fields.help: Integer minor units of the denomination (docs/logic-decisions.md #10). 15000 is $150.00/hour.

fields.name: increment_minutes
fields.label: Billing Increment
fields.help: Round each entry UP to this many minutes. 0 bills the time that actually happened; 6 and 15 are the common professional-services conventions. Because it can only ever increase a bill, state it on the card the client agreed to.

fields.name: valid_from
fields.label: Valid From
fields.help: The day this rate starts applying. Work done before it keeps the previous card's rate.

fields.name: is_active
fields.label: Active
fields.help: Retiring a card stops it applying to NEW work; it never restates hours already approved at that rate.
